question: What consequence follows if a house is built at an inauspicious time?
premises: A house may be made under the stated condition.
The consequence is destruction within a year.
inference: If a house is built at such a time, it will perish within a year.
uncertainties: The exact inauspicious condition is carried over from the previous verse.
plain_english: If one were to build a house then, it would perish within a year.
